title: The Clever Fox and the Ancient Owl

scenes.title: Encounter at Midnight
scenes.prompt: Deep magical woodland under glowing silver moonlight, ancient twisted oak tree with glowing moss, cinematic 3D style

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Deep in the Whispering Woods, where moonlight never touched the forest floor, Rusty the fox encountered the guardian of the grove.

dialogue.speaker: clever_fox
dialogue.text: Elder Owl! They say your knowledge spans a thousand winters. Tell me, how can a fox outsmart the winter frost?

dialogue.speaker: wise_owl
dialogue.text: Cleverness will only carry you so far, young fox. You cannot outrun the frost, but you can learn where the mountain shields the wind.
